Focker: The assault on the Solar Ray is a three-stage operation.
First, the first unit goes ahead and breaks a corner of the
enemy's defenses.

Focker: Next, the second unit throws the enemy's defenses into
disarray. Finally, the third unit charges into the Solar Ray.
Max: A simple plan.
Hikaru: Seems a little too simple, if you ask me...
Isamu: At times like this, a plan like that's better.

Focker: The Delaz Fleet is sure to target the Macross, with its
main cannon that can destroy the Solar Ray.
Focker: In other words, we can use the Macross as a diversion.

Emma: Then what will we do if the Solar Ray fires sooner than we
expect?
Focker: Well... we'll leave it to luck.
Chris: L-Leave it to luck... You mean if it fires first, it's all over?

Hikaru: I knew it... I figured your plan would be something like
that, Senpai.
Focker: Don't worry. I've got a way to buy time.

Quattro: Right after the operation begins, I'll call on the
Delaz Fleet to disarm.

Kamille: You, Capt. Quattro? Isn't the Delaz Fleet made up of
Zabi family loyalists?
Emma: ...Won't that backfire?

Focker: Considering the Captain's position, Lt. Emma may be
right.
Quattro: Yes... the Delaz Fleet's soldiers will never forgive me.

Quattro: But the fact is, unless we humans cast off our
attachment to the past, we can't overcome this crisis.
Amuro: ...So if we can settle this, we'll see a ray of hope.
Quattro: ...I think the chances are slim, though.

Quattro: But... first I must show that I can cast off my own
attachment to the past. Not as an act of playing the clown...
Kamille: (...)

Focker: It means using Capt. Quattro, but I've factored the
enemy's confusion over the surrender demand into buying time.

Judau: W-Wait a sec. What if that makes them mad and they blast
the Solar Ray?

Focker: It should take time before it can fire. We'll destroy the
Solar Ray quickly before then.
Hikaru: So it really is leaving it to luck...

Burning: But if they meant to use the Solar Ray to ambush us,
that'd be one thing...
Burning: now both we and the Jupitorians know it exists.

Burning: With that fortress appearing beyond lunar orbit, I think
Gihren will likely hold the Solar Ray in reserve.

Kou: Besides, Gato will want to settle things with us by his own
hand.
Quattro: (...)
Emma: (...)
Hikaru: (...I've got a bad feeling about this...)

Focker: If there are no other questions, that's all. The
operation begins in 40 minutes. Good luck, everyone.
Nina: Kou...
Kou: ...I'm busy getting ready to sortie. Can we talk later?

Nina: Don't tell me... you're going to volunteer for the Solar Ray
assault unit...?

Kou: Yeah. If it's Gato, I'm the one who has to go. We've been
bound by fate since Torrington Base.
Nina: Kou, please... Stop fighting Gato...

Nina: You said you'd wait until this war was over... but I can't
bear the two of you fighting...!
Kou: Capt. Quattro will call on the Delaz Fleet to disarm.
Nina: But if Gato doesn't agree...
Kou: ...Then I'll defeat Gato.
Nina: A fight like that is nothing but your own private feud!
Kou: That's not true!

Nina: Yes, it is! If there's any reason for you two to fight, it's
just your personal feelings... nothing but a grudge!
Kou: I intend to let go of the past too.

Kou: But if Gato won't accept that, I'm not going to just let that
man kill me.
Nina: I'm sorry... for saying something silly before your sortie...
Mora: What's wrong? You seemed pretty worked up...
Kou: ...It's nothing.

Mora: Hmm... well, fine. But don't forget, you've got something to
do besides shooting down enemies.
Kou: Something else to do?

Mora: ...Come back alive. Got it? If you make Nina cry, you'll
answer to me.
Kou: ...Got it, Mora.
Kou: (How long... will this fight go on? Until I catch Gato?)
Gato: ...So the Macross has appeared.

Kelley: Hmph... How did they sniff out that the Solar Ray was
hidden here?

Gato: Probably information leaked by the worm in our midst...
Cima Garahau. But such trifles no longer matter.

Gato: With the Solar Ray, I'll turn not only the Macross but even
the aliens into stardust in this space...

Kelley: These seven years... they seemed long, but looking back,
they were short.

Gato: Yes. Many comrades left this place, and new comrades
gathered here...

Kelley: And now, under Zeon's banner, our hopes are about to
take shape.

Gato: Not yet, Kelley. After we drive them off here, we deliver
the Solar Ray to Supreme Leader Gihren...

Gato: When we've exterminated the aliens, that's when the
hopes of all who died for Zeon's ideals will be rewarded.

Kelley: ...Vice Admiral Dozle dreamed of that day too, but fell
before his goal...

Gato: Exactly. With Vice Admiral Dozle gone, we're the only ones
left to be the sword that protects Zeon's ideals.
Kelley: Yeah. I'm prepared for that.

Gato: The Supreme Leader also deems destroying the Macross
unavoidable. We'll settle things with them here, by our own
hands, in one stroke.

Global: ...What effect did the Solar Ray's self-destruction have
on this ship?

Misa: No damage on our side. However, a considerable number of
Neo Zeon machines seem to have been caught in the explosion.
Focker: ...To think the Solar Ray itself was a booby trap...
Bright: Did the Delaz Fleet know about this?

Quattro: Judging from the battle just now, I don't think so. In a
sense, it's a ruthless plan very like Gihren Zabi...

Quattro: I'd like to think it was a measure taken for fear of the
Solar Ray falling into our hands.
Bright: (...)
Claudia: But does this mean Neo Zeon has lost its trump card?
Quattro: (...)

Vanessa: Captain! The Jupitorians are broadcasting a political
address to the entire Earth Sphere!
Global: Really!?
Vanessa: And... Princess Relena is in the footage...!
Quattro: !
Bright: Wh-What!?
Relena: I address all the people of the world.

Relena: I, Relena Peacecraft, have as of today become the
representative of the Jupiter power, the Jupitorians.
Relena: However, this is not for the Jupitorians' sake...

Relena: It is the first step on the best path we can walk
together with all of you, to end the world's conflicts and build an
era of peace.

Relena: Everyone... please lay down your arms and stop resisting
us.

Relena: Surely the future you wish for and the future the
Jupitorians will create are the same...

Relena: And the time has come when we must unite under one will
to overcome the greatest crisis humanity has ever faced...

Relena: I hereby declare the removal of the barriers between
factions and nations that are the source of the world's
conflicts, and the establishment of a new Earth Federation...
Relena: no, of a World Nation under the Jupitorians.

Milliardo: I am Milliardo Peacecraft... rightful heir to the throne of
the Sanc Kingdom, and an ally of the Jupitorians.

Milliardo: Our goal is to place Earth and the space colonies on
equal footing and build a new order in the Earth Sphere.
Milliardo: (.........)

Milliardo: Earth and the colonies... As history shows, these two
have created a pattern of conflict until now.
Milliardo: And we will erase that pattern.

Milliardo: If not everyone submits to the Jupitorians... I hereby
declare that we will purge Earth, the source of conflict.

Relena: People of the world... disarm, and choose the path of
coexistence with us...
Relena: Otherwise, we will...
Relena: We will.........
Relena: (...Heero... kill me...)
Global: So the Jupitorians have finally made an open move...!
Claudia: There's no doubt the Aerogaters are behind them.
Bright: What do you think, Capt. Quattro?
Quattro: (...)

Quattro: They're clearly buying time. With their forces and the
Aerogaters', unifying by force would be faster.

Quattro: Yet they go out of their way to put Princess Relena
forward...

Quattro: It's probably camouflage until they launch an operation
with that giant ring-shaped fortress.
Bright: Yes... most likely.

Vanessa: An emergency transmission from Cmdr. Henken at
Konpei Island.
Global: Understood. Put it on the main monitor.
Henken: Captain Global, an emergency has occurred.
Global: What happened?

Henken: During the battle between the Macross and the
Delaz Fleet...

Henken: what appears to be a colony laser was transported to
the A Baoa Qu area.
Global: What...!?
Bright: A colony laser!?

Henken: The Neo Zeon fleet most likely seized Gryps 2, a colony
the Titans were building as a military base...
Henken: and secretly converted it into a colony laser.
Global: So there were two Solar Rays...!
Bright: (...)

Global: As long as Neo Zeon has a colony laser, advancing on
A Baoa Qu like this would be unwise.
Global: We'd better return to Konpei Island once and regroup.
Bright: Agreed...

Glemy: Your Excellency Gihren... the Macross seems to be
returning to Solomon for now.

Gihren: Heh heh heh... A pity for them. Gryps 2 will be ready to
fire just a little sooner.
Glemy: ...And what of the Jupitorians' super-large fortress?

Gihren: Axis will hold it back. Haman's negotiations with Paptimus
Scirocco have broken down, after all...
Glemy: Then... you'll cut Axis loose?

Gihren: That was the plan from the start. If it comes to it,
there's also the option of self-destructing its nuclear pulse
engines.
Glemy: ...Also, a slightly troubling situation has arisen.
Gihren: What is it?

Glemy: Colonel M'Quve's fleet apparently made contact in satellite
orbit with someone who came up from Earth.
Gihren: M'Quve...?

Gihren: During the Earth drop operation, that man made contact
with a scientist called Dr. Hell to attack the Far East region.
Glemy: Then Dr. Hell has come up into space...?

Gihren: If it strengthens our forces, I don't mind... but
investigate the details.
Glemy: Yes, ma'am...

Gihren: ...Surely not. I can't imagine that woman is behind
M'Quve...
Gorgon: Great General of Darkness!
Great Gen. of Darkness: What is it?

Gorgon: It seems Char's Dakar speech has cost the Titans their
standing within the Earth Federation government.

Great Gen. of Darkness: Hoh... The Titans, you say?
That means one less power on the surface.

Gorgon: The aliens have sent forces to Earth as well, but the
Campbellians and the Boazan army have shown no movement.

Gorgon: Furthermore, the Byston Well forces suffered a defeat
against Londo Bell the other day, and is now regrouping.

Great Gen. of Darkness: Hmm... This situation suits
us well. How goes Dr. Hell's second operation to
conquer the Far East region?

Gorgon: Though he lost RyuOhKi and KoOhKi, the Dragonosaurus,
Gilgilgan and Pikudron have entered their final adjustments.

Gorgon: And of course, the first of that unit is complete, and
mass production is proceeding on schedule.

Great Gen. of Darkness: Heh heh heh heh... I see.
So Dr. Hell has succeeded in mass-producing it!

Great Gen. of Darkness: I can already picture the
looks on the faces of Londo Bell! Fwahahahaha!!

Dr. Hell: Count Brocken. Have the adjustments to the
Dragonosaurus, Gilgilgan and Pikudron been completed?
Brocken: Yes, sir.
Dr. Hell: And the mass-produced model?
Brocken: It is scheduled to roll out shortly.
Dr. Hell: I see. As expected of you, Count Brocken.

Dr. Hell: It seems the time has come to launch our
second operation to conquer the Far East...
Now then, Count Brocken...
Ashura: Please wait, Dr. Hell!
Dr. Hell: ...What is it, Baron Ashura?

Ashura: I beg you, entrust command of the second
Far East conquest operation to me, Ashura!
Ashura: Dr. Hell!

Dr. Hell: You have failed in nearly every operation so far. I
cannot entrust the next, crucial operation to you.
Ashura: B-But...!

Dr. Hell: Command of the second Far East operation goes to
Brocken. Send out the Dragonosaurus and the Pikudron!
Brocken: At once, sir.

Ashura: (O eternal star that shines through past, present and
future... Grant me but a fleeting moment of brilliance...)
Ashura: (Those cold eyes of Dr. Hell, staring down at me...)

Ashura: (Grant me the radiance of glory to shatter
Count Brocken's scornful gaze in flames...)
Ashura: (...I have grown so very weary...)
Ashura: (But... I cannot die without defeating Londo Bell!)
Ashura: (If it has come to this...!)
Dr. Hell: What is going on!?

Brocken: Dr. Hell! Baron Ashura has escaped
the secret base in the Budo!
Dr. Hell: What, Baron Ashura!?

Brocken: And he took the Dragonosaurus
and the Pikudron with him...!

Dr. Hell: That fool Baron Ashura has lost his mind!
Does he intend to die in a ditch!?

Brocken: Perhaps he deserted, knowing his
position had become precarious?
Dr. Hell: Hmph...

Brocken: Dr. Hell, our law is that traitors are
exterminated. I'll send a pursuit squad at once.

Dr. Hell: Wait. He can be killed at any time. If word
gets out that my own dog bit my hand, I'll only be
the laughingstock of Archduke Gorgon.

Dr. Hell: It will not be too late to act after we see
what Baron Ashura intends to do.

Keel: With the Dakar speech by the AEUG's Char Aznable, the
Titans have lost their standing...
Voice: And the Romefeller Foundation's response?
Voice: They intend to cut the Titans loose.

Voice: That force still has its uses. We'll replace its head with
our own hands and quietly reorganize it...

Ele: Then, Princess Relena of the Sanc Kingdom
was taken away by OZ's Brigadier General Treize...?
Igor: That is correct.

Igor: Even so, the Sanc Kingdom has since come under fierce
attack by the Jupitorians, and we have lost contact with them...

Ele: Sho and the others are with Queen Ciela's
forces. They should be all right.
Igor: ...I believe so as well.
Ele: ...And Commander Bright's unit?

Igor: ...They succeeded in seizing the Federation Assembly in
Dakar, and Captain Quattro denounced the Titans.
Ele: I see... That alone succeeding is a blessing.
Abe: Princess Ele, the Evangelion team has returned.
Ele: Understood. Please prepare to receive them at once...

might be due for an overhaul soon.

you'd be pissed off too, wouldn't you...?

Koji: (...)
